---
title: "Firecrown Tutorial Documents"
---

Welcome to the Firecrown Tutorial Documentation.
The site has three parts:

- **Introduction**: an [introductory article](intro_article.qmd) on Firecrown in general terms, with a small development example.
- **Tutorials**: documents on specific parts of Firecrown, starting with [inferred redshift distributions](tomographic_bin.qmd) and the [two-point framework](two_point_framework.qmd). All tutorials are listed in the sidebar.
- **Cookbook**: [short recipes](cookbook/index.qmd), one task each. Every recipe can be downloaded as a Jupyter notebook.

Installation instructions and the API reference are in the [main documentation](../index.html).
